newsitem.title: USA: Case unit prices $850 mln securitization.
newsitem.headline: Case unit prices $850 mln securitization.

text.p: Case Credit Corp said Thursday its Case Receivables II Inc subsidiary priced an $850 million asset-backed securitization, the unit's largest transaction to date.

The issue includes $34 million of 6.95 percent asset-backed certificates and three classes of public notes: $125 million of 5.5625 percent Class A-1 notes, $362 million of 6.25 percent Class A-2 notes and $329 million of 6.65 percent Class A-3 notes.
Including the latest securitization, Case Credit will have issued $1.48 billion of public asset-backed securities this year, compared with $1.25 billion in 1995.
Case Credit is a unit of Case Corp.
